codeatlas/ecommerce.value: The project uses a convention of not marking orders as canceled unless all associated stock release operations succeed, allowing for potential retries in failure scenarios.

In the '_reserve_all_items' method of the OrderManager class, if a reservation fails, all prior successful reservations are rolled back by calling '_release_items', followed by raising a ValueError. This prevents a scenario where stock remains held for an order that will not be created.
Added comments in `_reserve_all_items` for improved clarity on stock reservation failure handling.
